notes: BOI approved (6 May 2026) a THB 842bn (~USD 25bn) data-centre expansion covering server installation, data-storage and processing capacity across Bangkok, Samut Prakan and Chachoengsao. Follows earlier commitments: USD 3.8bn approved Jan 2025 and USD 8.8bn over five years announced Feb 2025. TNW calls Chachoengsao Thailand's primary data-centre cluster. No MW split published.
